title: PRD: Key Control & Authorization Decision Log + Evidence Checklist
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Summary: This PRD records final decisions about key control and authorization for Private deployments (VPC / on-prem) and defines an evidence-driven sign-off checklist. Goals are: 1) establish a deterministic acceptance path for SSO/SAML federation, RBAC role bindings, audit logging/retention, and KMS/HSM key custody; 2) document trade-offs and operational responsibilities; 3) produce verifiable artifacts for compliance and customer onboarding. In-scope: SSO/SAML federation (IdP metadata ingestion, cert rotation, SAML assertion validation), RBAC role model and bootstrap scripts, audit log schema + retention + searchability, KMS integration patterns (CMEK/HSM flow) and operator runbooks. Out-of-scope: application-level encryption patterns outside KMS/HSM, multi-cloud key escrow strategies (tracked separately).
acceptance_criteria: SSO/SAML: Automated federation test passes against a staging IdP (metadata exchange, signature validation, SAML attributes mapping) and test artifacts (SAML trace, signed assertion) are attached.
RBAC: Role matrix published and verified with least-privilege demo. Bootstrap tooling creates roles with reproducible IDs and tests show non-privileged user cannot access operator endpoints.

Audit logs: Indexing and retention configured for 365 days in private deployments; sample query demonstrates evidence of a simulated privilege escalation event. Auditing schema documented and fields mapped to compliance requirements.
KMS/HSM: Customer master key import/export flow, rotation, and decryption compliance test executed. HSM-backed key usage trace for 30-day simulated workload available as evidence.
Operators: Operator runbook and emergency key-rotation procedure validated in an air-gapped dry-run; runbook links and acceptance signers listed.

Rollout gates: Canary rollout plan executed (10% pods -> 50% -> 100%) with automated health checks and fallback to hosted runtime if any SLO breach occurs; rollbacks exercised in staging and recorded.

Evidence & Traceability: All evidence items (confluence docs, test reports, PRs) are linked in this ticket and stored in the release evidence folder in Drive for audit retrieval. Sign-off requires Security, SRE, and Product assurance signatures.
Backward compatibility: Private customers can pin previous key policies without requiring immediate rotation; migration plan with timelines present in docs.

notes: Trade-off: Enforcing HSM-only key generation increases onboarding friction for small customers but simplifies audit evidence for enterprise. We default to KMS with optional HSM for enterprise customers.
Decision: RBAC will use an RBAC v2 schema to support resource-scoped roles; backwards-compat handled via compatibility shim for older agent versions.
Follow-up: Create an internal training module for support and sales covering customer-facing keying options and limitations.
